💬 “By the end of the weekend, Kimi’s package was clearly the faster of the two which gives us confidence that we are heading in the right direction from a development perspective.”
Hear from Kimi, George, Toto and Shov after the Singapore Grand Prix 🗞️ 👇

detailZh:
💬 “本周末结束时，基米的套件显然比另一个更快，这让我们有信心，从开发角度来看，我们正在朝着正确的方向前进。”
新加坡大奖赛之后，听听基米、乔治、托托和肖夫的看法 🗞️ 👇
